chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Ibn al-Arzymi, from his father, from Jabir al-Ju'fi, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

When you wish to know that there is goodness in you, look at your heart. If it loves the people of obedience to Allah and hates the people of His disobedience, then there is goodness in you and Allah loves you. And if it hates the people of obedience to Allah and loves the people of His disobedience, then there is no goodness in you and Allah hates you. And the person is with the one whom he loves.

key_terms.الْمَرْءُ مَعَ مَنْ أَحَبَّ: The person is with the one whom he loves

ai.seo_question: How can I know if I have goodness in my heart according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This diagnostic criterion from al-Kafi emphasizes that spiritual health is determined by one's innate affinity for the righteous and aversion to the sinful, reflecting the Shia concept of *al-wala' wa al-barra*. The concluding phrase 'the person is with whom they love' links this internal state to the eschatological reality of resurrection, a theme deeply rooted in both Quranic and Hadith traditions.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Ibn Al Arzamy, from his father, from Jabir Al Ju’fy, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> having said:

‘Whenever you intend to know that there is goodness in you, so look at your heart. So if it loves the people obedient to Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> and hates the people disobedient to Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>, so there is goodness in you and Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Loves you. And if it was so that it hates the people obedient to Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> and loves the people disobedient to Him<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>, so there is no goodnes in you and Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Hates you. And the person would be with the one who he loves’.
en.sarwar: 11. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from ibn al-‘Arzami from his father from Jabir al-Juhfi from abu Ja’far (a.s.) who has said the following: “

If you like to know whether there is anything good in you, look into your heart. If it loves people who obey Allah and hates those who disobey Him, then there is good in you and Allah loves you. If it hates the people who obey Allah and loves those who disobey Allah, then there is nothing good in you and Allah hates you. A man is with what he loves.”
